Use case: illustration-story. Generate ONE standalone 16:9 horizontal Chinese blog body illustration, target canvas 1536x864. Pure #FFFFFF white background, minimalist thin BLACK hand-drawn pen lines, slightly wobbly, ample empty white space (at least 35%). Sparse flat orange #E67E22, red #D84436 and blue #3478B8 accents only. No gradient, shadow, paper texture, dense UI, realistic rendering, corporate vector look, slide/PPT design, childish cuteness or decorative header. No top-left title, no watermark, no caption outside scene.
Character: XiaoM 小M, a small BLACK mushroom creature, black rounded dome cap, pale white stem body with black dot eyes, tiny thin arms and legs, deadpan serious expression. This deliberately uses the user's requested black mushroom instead of the default red cap. Black cap and outline, keep eyes clearly visible on pale stem. XiaoM must actively perform the core action, not stand as decoration. Handwritten Chinese labels must be clean, legible and exact. Simple strange physical metaphor, not a formal systems diagram. Keep wide clean margins so the whole scene fits a 16:9 final crop.
Core idea: AppFlowy's open client, archived legacy server and CURRENT COMMERCIAL SELF-HOST PACKAGE are THREE DIFFERENT things with DIFFERENT licensing. Scene: exactly three separate, clearly spaced hand-drawn physical sorting boxes on a low white shelf; each has a generous clearly legible label. XiaoM is between boxes physically inserting a tall divider board, carefully keeping the current commercial box separate from the open client box. A few sheets suggest client source in box one; a closed dusty archive folder WITHOUT any dust texture in box two; a closed deployment parcel plus a single Compose sheet in box three, no open-source symbol on it. Sparse orange placement marks, red archive/commercial notes, blue secondary closed-source note. Slightly irregular positions, not a tidy corporate three-column slide.
Only these labels, associated unambiguously with their box:
Box one: “开源客户端”, small “AGPL-3.0”.
Box two: “旧版服务端”, red “已归档”.
Box three: “当前自托管包”, red “商业许可”, blue “服务端闭源”.
Do NOT suggest that public deployment files make the current server fully open source. No shared open-source umbrella, no checkmark suggesting equivalence, no arrow turning old into new, no license resale permission, no costs.

Core idea: trace where document data can travel; self-hosting is a boundary decision, NOT compliance certification. Scene: a strange cutaway of a white storage cabinet encircled by ONE thin black hand-drawn dashed boundary. XiaoM acts as document route inspector: holding a small document and physically following its orange route across the authentication gate into the storage cabinet with one database cylinder and attachment folder. A branch goes to a separate backup drawer outside the cabinet boundary; another conditional branch crosses boundary to an external blue AI cloud on the right. Keep it to four core destinations, natural organic route, not dense network architecture. Identity sits at the entrance as a key-slot gate. Give all flows small clear arrowheads: document -> identity gate -> selfhost storage; storage -> backup destination; storage -> external AI with conditional note. No green checkmarks, compliance seal, security shield or certification badge. Backup drawer denotes destination to inspect, never a claim backups are proven.
Only exact short labels: document “文档”; gate “身份认证”; cabinet “自托管存储”, small “数据库·附件”; backup drawer “备份去向”; blue cloud “外部 AI”; red note at AI crossing “启用时出界”; small red note below the cabinet boundary “边界≠认证”.
XiaoM must be centrally participating in inspecting this route. Orange for content route and arrowheads; blue for AI cloud and supplemental marks; red for boundary warning. Broad quiet white areas above/below. No complete offline claim.

Core idea: hand over concrete evidence of migration, access permissions and restoration; keep SOFTWARE LICENSE BILL separate from IMPLEMENTATION SERVICE BILL. Scene: serious black mushroom XiaoM actively slides an open, slightly absurd oversized handover folder across a white desk toward an administrator's simple receiving hand on the right. Folder contains exactly THREE clearly visible short evidence cards, spread like a fan without overlap of text: (1) two representative matching document sheets and a paperclip attachment pair, (2) two account key entries, one access line and one red crossed-out key to show revocation, (3) backup copy arrow leading to an opened readable document in a tiny isolated test tray. These are example acceptance evidence deliverables, not a claim the article performed a real migration or restore. No completion trophy or generic success stamp.
At lower right, separated by a clear white gap from the handover evidence folder, exactly TWO separate billing sheets, neither overlapping or bundled: one titled “软件许可账单” with a tiny license-key symbol; the other titled “实施服务账单” with a tiny wrench symbol. Plain short blank item lines, NO digits, NO currency symbols, NO totals.
Use only these seven short Chinese labels: above receiving hand “交接”; evidence cards “迁移对照”, “权限记录”, “恢复记录”; tiny note on restore test tray “隔离验证”; bill headings “软件许可账单”, “实施服务账单”.
Orange for handover movement and small restore route; red for revoked key and separation mark between bills; blue for evidence notes. Keep lots of blank white space. No money, currency amounts, profit guarantees, legal certification or claim software resale is authorized.
